list.item: To the Reichstag belongs a penal power over its members in regard to every breach of propriety committed by them in the exercise of their duty.

This penal power shall be exercised by a committee composed of the president, the two vice-presidents, and ten members. These last are elected at the beginning of the session immediately after the election of the president for the whole duration of the session.

The punishments which the committee can inflict according to the gravity of the offense are: 1st. A reprimand before the assembly. 2d. An apology or retraction
before the assembly. 3d. Exclusion from the Reichstag for a certain time, which may be extended to the end of the session.

If the punishment in § 3 is inflicted for an expression or for the substance of a speech, the expression or the speech as a whole, or the portion of the speech considered improper, will not be reproduced in the stenographic report.

The committee acts: 1st. When the president requests it to; 2d. When twenty members at least of the Reichstag demand it. This request or demand must be made within the space of three days after the offense has been committed.

The committee deliberates and decides under the presidency of the president, and in case of his unavoidable absence, of the first vice-president, with the assistance of at least seven members. The order of proceeding is established by rules drawn up by the committee and submitted to the approval of the Reichstag.

The decision of the committee is final. Nevertheless, if exclusion from the Reichstag is decreed, the excluded member may, within eight days after the sentence, appeal from it in writing to the decision of the Reichstag.

The president has the right to forbid temporarily the reprinting in the stenographic report of improper expressions of members, as also to forbid temporarily any other publication of the words by the public press. Such a temporary interdict expires if, in the space of three days, the committee has not received an invitation or a demand to give a decision in regard to the words in question.

Any infraction of the regulation contained in§ 4, as also of the temporary interdict of the president authorized in§ 8, will be punishable with imprisonment from three weeks to three months, if, according to the substance of the publication of such words, there is no occasion for a more severe punishment.
Any questions brought before the committee, which have not been decided at the close of a session, shall be transferred in the state they may be to the committee of the next session of the Reichstag.
